speaker: Doctor
text:
Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. You mentioned having a psychiatric condition and a new onset movement disorder; can you tell me specifically what movements you are experiencing and how long they have been present?

REQUEST TEST: Brain_MRI, EEG, TSH, Copper_level

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: TSH: 2.5 mIU/L; Normal Readings for Brain_MRI, EEG, Copper_level

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for describing those distressing symptoms of inner restlessness and repetitive movements. To better understand if this is related to your psychiatric history or a metabolic issue, have you noticed any tremors, stiffness, or changes in your vision? REQUEST TEST: Ophthalmology_Exam, Full_Blood_Count, Liver_Function_Tests. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI_Sagittal_Views, MRI_Axial_Sequences.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given the normal results from your liver function, blood count, and copper levels, along with your psychiatric history, have you noticed any involuntary eye movements or difficulty swallowing recently?

REQUEST TEST: Drug_Level_Panel, Ophthalmology_Scan.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-Induced Hyperkinetic Movement Disorder (likely due to antipsychotic medication).
